subject: POC outcomes — KPI highlights & 15-min case story invite
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Hare <liam.ohare@quickcart.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: POC outcomes — KPI highlights & 15-min case story invite

Hi Liam,

Thanks again for running the week-long POC with our Nebula runtime. Your team was great to work with and we’re really happy with the results. I wanted to share a concise recap (attached) with the most material metrics and to ask a small favor.

Quick highlights from the POC:
- Average 95th percentile latency: 110ms (down from your 320ms baseline)
- Token cost reduction (per 1k tokens): 38% using batching + KV prefix cache
- Inference throughput: sustained 1.8k requests/min under realistic traffic replay
- Error rate during throughput run: 0.2% (timeouts only during one 3-min window)

The attached PDF has the full charts and a payload sample (kv-tagging-sample.json). We’re putting together a short customer story library to help other engineering teams evaluate tradeoffs and would love to include a two-line quote from QuickCart and—if you’re open to it—a 15-minute recorded call for a short case story (we can use audio only). Example ask: a single sentence about the impact on latency and a one-line permission to attribute QuickCart as a reference. Nothing heavy.

Suggested next steps:
1) If OK, quick permission for a 2-line quote + permission to use QuickCart logo in a case snippet
2) 15-minute slot this week for a light recording (we can do Wed 11/24 10:00-10:15 PT or Thu 11/25 9:00-9:15 PT)

If you prefer, Marcus can draft the quote and Monica will handle the recording logistics.

Thanks again — very excited by the improvement you saw.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Customer Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198
